Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Forms of EMD and PBG

Branch address NCR BIOTECH SCIENCE CLUSTER, FARIDABAD . Bidder to indicate bid number and name of bidding entity in the transaction details field at the time of on- line transfer. Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the Online Payment Transfer along with bid. 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. The operating Voltage of the system should 230V, 50Hz. 2. System should have IP21 rating for cleanability and protection of sensitive elec tronics. 3. The system should be compatible for fermentation as well as mammalian cell c ulture experiments. 4. Also the bidders are requested to submit their quote (rates) for subsequent 05 years comprehensive AMC (including all spares, accessories and labour) failure to comply with this condition will entail the rejection of the bids. The price comp arison shall be made considering the basic price and post warranty CMC. 5. A satisfactory performance certificate should be submitted from minimum five users where the quote model has been installed. 6. Regular calibration, including preventive maintenance, all-inclusive labour, and required consumables/ kits , is to be provided by the vendor during the warrant y period. 7. Installation of the instrument and accessories should be done free of cost; ven dor has to make own arrangements for manpower/ labour involved for shifting, carrying out installation proceedings in lab. Institute will not provide any kind la bour support. 8. There must be after sales service support available in the Delhi-NCR. 9. Compliance to each of the above points should be separately indicated and evi dence presence for each of them (Product brochures should be highlighted whe rever required). Certificate of calibration and inspection from factory to be suppl ied with system. 10. Original company literature with offered specifications should be enclosed with the bid failing which the bid may be treated non-responsive. 11. Only Standard Models should be quoted and custom-made products will not be considered. product must be available on official website of supplier 12. The supplier should provide the demo of the quoted product if required. 13. Credibility: The vendor should demonstrate a record of successful installations of at least 10 installations of quoted models in Govt. institutions/research centre

s across India. A comprehensive list of prior installations should be provided. 14. The system should be compatible to operate single use vessel up to 10L capaci ty. Scope of Supply Supply, installation, training and final acceptance tests at RCB Faridabad Training Training to be provided to the researchers on site after installation of the equip ment Please refer buyer uploaded ATC for complete specifications. For Procurement Goods & Services a) Compliance (acceptance/non acceptance) with each of the technical specifications as mentioned in the bid document should be separately indicated on a document and evidence presented for each of them (Pr oduct brochures/catalogue should be highlighted wherever required). (b)Supply of the same model should have been carried out by at least 03 reputed public research institutio ns in India. Satisfactory user certificates from 3 of them should be presented. This should be uploaded und er ATC document(s) as required in the bid. (c)Fall Clause: Fall clause is a price safety mechanism. A declaration as per the format given below is to be given by the supplier on their letterhead. FALL CLAUSE NOTICE CERTIFICATE This is to certify that we have offered the maximum possible discount to you in our Bid No.________dated _ ______ The prices charged for the stores supplied should under no event be higher than lowest prices at which th e party sells the items of identical description to any other Govt. organisation/PSU’s/Autonomous bodies/Pv t. Organisations during the period of contract failing which the “FALL CLAUSE” will be applicable. In case, if the price charged by our firm is more, RCB will have the right to recover the excess charged am ount from the subsequent/unpaid bill of the supplier. Seal and Signature of the tenderer. Note: This letter of authority should be on the letterhead of the quoting firm and should be signed by a per son competent and having the power of attorney to bind the same. (d) It is hereby informed that the warranty shall be 'on-site'. Vendors are requested to take note of the sa me before quoting. (e) For detailed specifications vendor may refer to Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Document. If there is any contravention in the specifications published on GeM and those in the ATC document. Requirements as eli cited in the ATC Document shall prevail. Bidders are requested to quote accordingly. (f) The vendor has to upload an undertaking on their letter head declaring full acceptance of the bid terms and conditions including the ATC's. Non-compliance of the same will lead to disqualification of the bid. (g)Bidder may be asked to show a demonstration of the quoted product if the purchasing department so d eems fit. In case no demonstration is provided, the seller shall be rejected. Post the demonstration, decisio n of the RCB technical sub-committee shall be final. (h)The product should carry a warranty of 3 years. Mention of any other value in the bid document in this r egard may be ignored. Vendors are requested to quote their prices accordingly. No later queries or dispute

s in this regard shall be entertained. (i) For detailed specifications please refer buyer uploaded document. (j)Technical Evaluation strictly be done on the basis of Buyer added Terms and conditions (k)The Firm Shall submit the EMD in the form of DD/FD/BG in Favour of EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR RCB Payable at Faridabad. (l)The payment shall be made via direct bank transfer or 100% LC after successful installation and com missioning of the equipment subject to submission of the BG and confirmation of the same.
